trans-unit.source: After accepting your coin the stranger Introduces himself as a fellow asur named Idrinth. Taking off his travel ropes you see the battle worn armor of a lore master, a matching greatsword and a metal bow near stoic eyes hinting at brutalities yet to be committed.
trans-unit.target: Após aceitar sua moeda, o estranho se apresenta como um companheiro asur chamado Idrinth. Tirando seus mantos de viagem, você vê a armadura de combate de um mestre do saber, uma espada larga combinando e um arco de metal perto de olhos estoicos que sugerem brutalidades ainda por cometer.

trans-unit.source: The stranger lowers his hood, revealing elven features. I am no friend of destruction, but our enemies forced my hand. Pocketing his coins he states, Returning to family after many years when they are in danger is right, no matter who that family is. Don't you agree?
trans-unit.target: O estranho abaixa seu capuz, revelando feições élficas. Não sou amigo da destruição, mas nossos inimigos forçaram minha mão. Guardando suas moedas, ele declara: Retornar à família após muitos anos quando estão em perigo é certo, não importa quem seja essa família. Você não concorda?

trans-unit.source: I have fought and bled with warriors believing in Ulfic or Sigmar. We have the same foes, he states as he removes his travel robes, and I look forward to driving them back with you. Sharing my knowledge for the betterment of the world. His eyes look coldly at praying humans before returning their attention to the general and his guard.
trans-unit.target: Eu lutei e sangrei com guerreiros que acreditam em Ulric ou Sigmar. Temos os mesmos inimigos, ele declara enquanto remove seus mantos de viagem, e espero expulsá-los junto com vocês. Compartilhando meu conhecimento para o bem do mundo. Seus olhos olham friamente para humanos orando antes de retornar sua atenção ao general e sua guarda.

trans-unit.source: I look forward to fighting alongside the hunters of the woods, cousin, states the asur in a friendly tone while packing his payment and travel cloak. I may not be as great of a shot as you are, but I won't slow you down. A slightly amused smile plays around his bloodless lips before disappearing. Let us have a hunt that will be told of in centuries still!
trans-unit.target: Espero lutar ao lado dos caçadores das florestas, primo, declara o asur em tom amigável enquanto guarda seu pagamento e manto de viagem. Posso não ser tão bom atirador quanto vocês, mas não vou atrasá-los. Um sorriso levemente divertido brinca em seus lábios sem sangue antes de desaparecer. Vamos ter uma caçada que será contada por séculos!

trans-unit.source: The stranger disrobes himself after having been payed and reveals an elven face and elven weaponry beneath his travel robes. My name is Idrinth, I have been fighting our foes for longer than most of you have lived. I would enjoy practicing with the force and teaching them. A slight smile plays around his bloodless lips before it disappears in an ageless face.
trans-unit.target: O estranho se despe após receber o pagamento e revela um rosto élfico e armamento élfico sob seus mantos de viagem. Meu nome é Idrinth, tenho lutado contra nossos inimigos por mais tempo do que a maioria de vocês viveu. Eu gostaria de praticar com a força e ensiná-los. Um leve sorriso brinca em seus lábios sem sangue antes de desaparecer em um rosto sem idade.

trans-unit.source: The stranger pulls back his hood, revealing features unmistakably Asur—yet his eyes hold none of their typical disdain. "Cousin," he says, the word carrying neither mockery nor warmth. "I care nothing for ancient grudges. Chaos devours Druchii and Asur alike, and I have learned that survival demands... flexibility." A mirthless smile crosses his bloodless lips. "You understand pragmatism better than most. Shall we put it to use?"
trans-unit.target: O estranho puxa seu capuz para trás, revelando feições inconfundivelmente Asur—contudo seus olhos não carregam o desdém típico. Primo, ele diz, a palavra não carregando nem zombaria nem calor. Não me importo com rancores antigos. O Caos devora Druchii e Asur igualmente, e aprendi que a sobrevivência exige... flexibilidade. Um sorriso sem alegria cruza seus lábios sem sangue. Você entende pragmatismo melhor do que a maioria. Devemos colocá-lo em uso?

trans-unit.source: The stranger's hood falls away, revealing an elven face untouched by time. "I know what you serve," he says flatly, meeting the gaze of the undead without flinching. "And I know what I am. We need not pretend otherwise." He adjusts the greatsword at his back with familiar ease. "Nagash's enemies are Chaos' servants. For now, that alignment of purpose is enough." His bloodless lips twist into something resembling dark amusement. "The Great Necromancer collects all things eventually. I simply choose the terms."
trans-unit.target: O capuz do estranho cai, revelando um rosto élfico intocado pelo tempo. Sei a quem você serve, ele diz friamente, encontrando o olhar dos mortos-vivos sem pestanejar. E sei o que sou. Não precisamos fingir o contrário. Ele ajusta a espada larga em suas costas com facilidade familiar. Os inimigos de Nagash são servos do Caos. Por ora, esse alinhamento de propósito é suficiente. Seus lábios sem sangue se torcem em algo parecido com diversão sombria. O Grande Necromante coleta todas as coisas eventualmente. Eu simplesmente escolho os termos.

trans-unit.source: The stranger sheds his salt-stained cloak, revealing elven features and ancient armor beneath. "I've sailed darker seas than these," he remarks, eyeing the shambling crew without disgust. "Blood is blood, whether taken on land or water." He produces his payment pouch, weighing it thoughtfully. "You hunt, you raid, you survive. I respect that." A knowing smile crosses his pale face. "And I suspect your captains understand—immortality changes one's perspective on... everything."
trans-unit.target: O estranho se desfaz de seu manto manchado de sal, revelando feições élficas e armadura antiga por baixo. Naveguei mares mais escuros do que estes, ele comenta, observando a tripulação cambaleante sem nojo. Sangue é sangue, seja tomado em terra ou água. Ele produz sua bolsa de pagamento, pesando-a pensativamente. Vocês caçam, saqueiam, sobrevivem. Respeito isso. Um sorriso conhecedor cruza seu rosto pálido. E suspeito que seus capitães entendam—a imortalidade muda a perspectiva de alguém sobre... tudo.

trans-unit.source: The stranger removes his traveling cloak with practiced grace, revealing elven armor beneath. "I have served alongside knights before," he says, inclining his head with courtly precision. "Honor and duty transcend the boundaries of race. Your Lady protects these lands, and I would see them defended from the darkness that consumes all." His pale features remain composed, though his bloodless lips betray no warmth. "Let us ride against our common foe."
trans-unit.target: O estranho remove seu manto de viagem com graça praticada, revelando armadura élfica por baixo. Servi ao lado de cavaleiros antes, ele diz, inclinando a cabeça com precisão cortês. Honra e dever transcendem as fronteiras de raça. Sua Dama protege estas terras, e eu as veria defendidas da escuridão que consome tudo. Suas feições pálidas permanecem compostas, embora seus lábios sem sangue não revelem calor. Cavalgemos contra nosso inimigo comum.

trans-unit.source: The robed figure bows with unexpected formality, then straightens to reveal elven features beneath his traveling garments. "I have walked your lands before, in ages past," he states, his voice measured and calm. "The Great Bastion holds back horrors I know all too well. Balance must be maintained against the Ruinous Powers." His ageless eyes study the Cathayan officials with scholarly interest. "I offer knowledge spanning millennia. Perhaps we can learn from one another."
trans-unit.target: A figura encapuzada se curva com formalidade inesperada, então se endireita para revelar feições élficas sob suas vestimentas de viagem. Caminhei por suas terras antes, em eras passadas, ele declara, sua voz medida e calma. A Grande Muralha detém horrores que conheço muito bem. O equilíbrio deve ser mantido contra os Poderes Ruinosos. Seus olhos sem idade estudam os oficiais de Cathay com interesse acadêmico. Ofereço conhecimento abrangendo milênios. Talvez possamos aprender um com o outro.

trans-unit.source: The stranger pulls back his hood, revealing features unmistakably Asur—yet his eyes hold none of their typical disdain. "Cousin," he says, the word carrying neither mockery nor warmth. "I care nothing for ancient grudges. Chaos devours Druchii and Asur alike, and I have learned that survival demands... flexibility." A mirthless smile crosses his bloodless lips. "You understand pragmatism better than most. Shall we put it to use?"
trans-unit.target: Cizinec stahuje kapuci a odhaluje rysy nepopiratelně Asur—přesto jeho oči nedrží nic z jejich typického opovržení. "Bratranče," říká, slovo nenese ani výsměch, ani vřelost. "Nestarám se o prastaré křivdy. Chaos pohlcuje Druchii i Asur, a naučil jsem se, že přežití vyžaduje... flexibilitu." Bezradostný úsměv přechází přes jeho bezkrevné rty. "Rozumíte pragmatismu lépe než většina. Využijeme ho?"

trans-unit.source: The stranger's hood falls away, revealing an elven face untouched by time. "I know what you serve," he says flatly, meeting the gaze of the undead without flinching. "And I know what I am. We need not pretend otherwise." He adjusts the greatsword at his back with familiar ease. "Nagash's enemies are Chaos' servants. For now, that alignment of purpose is enough." His bloodless lips twist into something resembling dark amusement. "The Great Necromancer collects all things eventually. I simply choose the terms."
trans-unit.target: Kapuce cizince padá a odhaluje elfí tvář nedotčenou časem. "Vím, čemu sloužíte," říká ploše, setkávaje se s pohledem nemrtvých bez mrknutí. "A vím, čím jsem. Nemusíme předstírat jinak." Upravuje obouručný meč na zádech se známou lehkostí. "Nagashovi nepřátelé jsou služebníky Chaosu. Prozatím toto sladění účelu stačí." Jeho bezkrevné rty se zkroutí v něco připomínajícího temné pobavení. "Velký nekromant nakonec sbírá všechny věci. Já si pouze vybírám podmínky."

trans-unit.source: The stranger sheds his salt-stained cloak, revealing elven features and ancient armor beneath. "I've sailed darker seas than these," he remarks, eyeing the shambling crew without disgust. "Blood is blood, whether taken on land or water." He produces his payment pouch, weighing it thoughtfully. "You hunt, you raid, you survive. I respect that." A knowing smile crosses his pale face. "And I suspect your captains understand—immortality changes one's perspective on... everything."
trans-unit.target: Cizinec shazuje svůj solí potřísněný plášť a odhaluje elfí rysy a prastarou zbroj pod ním. "Plavil jsem se temnějšími moři než toto," poznamenává, pozorujíc potácející se posádku bez znechucení. "Krev je krev, ať vzatá na zemi nebo na vodě." Vytahuje měšec s platbou, zamyšleně ho vážíc. "Lovíte, plenujete, přežíváte. Respektuji to." Vědoucí úsměv přechází přes jeho bledou tvář. "A podezřívám, že vaši kapitáni rozumí—nesmrtelnost mění perspektivu na... všechno."

trans-unit.source: The stranger removes his traveling cloak with practiced grace, revealing elven armor beneath. "Let us ride against our common foe."
trans-unit.target: Cizinec sundává svůj cestovní plášť s cvičenou grácií a odhaluje elfí zbroj pod ním. "Sloužil jsem po boku rytířů dříve," říká, naklánějíc hlavu s dvorní přesností. "Čest a povinnost přesahují hranice ras. Vaše Paní chrání tyto země a já bych je viděl chráněny před temnotou, která pohlcuje vše." Jeho bledé rysy zůstávají vyrovnané, ačkoli jeho bezkrevné rty nevyzrazují žádné teplo. "Vyražme proti našemu společnému nepříteli."

trans-unit.source: The robed figure bows with unexpected formality, then straightens to reveal elven features beneath his traveling garments. Perhaps we can learn from one another."
trans-unit.target: Zahalená postava se uklání s nečekanou formálností, pak se narovná a odhalí elfí rysy pod cestovním oděvem. "Kráčel jsem vašimi zeměmi dříve, v dávných věcích," prohlašuje, jeho hlas odměřený a klidný. "Velká bašta drží zpět hrůzy, které znám až příliš dobře. Rovnováha musí být udržena proti Zhoubným silám." Jeho bezčasé oči studují cathayské úředníky s učeneckým zájmem. "Nabízím znalosti sahající tisíciletí. Možná se můžeme učit jeden od druhého."

A mirthless smile crosses his bloodless lips. "You understand pragmatism better than most. Shall we put it to use?"
trans-unit.target: L'étranger repousse sa capuche, révélant des traits indubitablement Asur — pourtant ses yeux ne portent rien de leur dédain habituel. « Cousin », dit-il, le mot ne portant ni moquerie ni chaleur. « Je me moque des anciennes rancunes. Le Chaos dévore Druchii et Asur également, et j'ai appris que la survie exige... de la flexibilité. » Un sourire sans joie traverse ses lèvres exsangues. « Vous comprenez le pragmatisme mieux que la plupart. Allons-nous le mettre à profit ? »

trans-unit.source: The stranger's hood falls away, revealing an elven face untouched by time. "I know what you serve," he says flatly, meeting the gaze of the undead without flinching. "And I know what I am. We need not pretend otherwise." He adjusts the greatsword at his back with familiar ease. "Nagash's enemies are Chaos' servants. For now, that alignment of purpose is enough." His bloodless lips twist into something resembling dark amusement. "The Great Necromancer collects all things eventually. I simply choose the terms."
trans-unit.target: La capuche de l'étranger tombe, révélant un visage elfique intact par le temps. « Je sais qui vous servez », dit-il platement, soutenant le regard des morts-vivants sans broncher. « Et je sais ce que je suis. Nous n'avons pas besoin de prétendre le contraire. » Il ajuste la grande épée à son dos avec une aisance familière. « Les ennemis de Nagash sont les serviteurs du Chaos. Pour l'instant, cet alignement d'objectifs suffit. » Ses lèvres exsangues se tordent en quelque chose ressemblant à un sombre amusement. « Le Grand Nécromancien collecte toutes choses finalement. Je choisis simplement les termes. »

trans-unit.source: The stranger sheds his salt-stained cloak, revealing elven features and ancient armor beneath. "I've sailed darker seas than these," he remarks, eyeing the shambling crew without disgust. "Blood is blood, whether taken on land or water." He produces his payment pouch, weighing it thoughtfully. "You hunt, you raid, you survive. I respect that." A knowing smile crosses his pale face. "And I suspect your captains understand—immortality changes one's perspective on... everything."
trans-unit.target: L'étranger se défait de sa cape tachée de sel, révélant des traits elfiques et une armure ancienne en dessous. « J'ai navigué sur des mers plus sombres que celles-ci », remarque-t-il, regardant l'équipage chancelant sans dégoût. « Le sang est le sang, qu'il soit pris sur terre ou sur l'eau. » Il sort sa bourse de paiement, la soupesant pensivement. « Vous chassez, vous pillez, vous survivez. Je respecte cela. » Un sourire entendu traverse son visage pâle. « Et je soupçonne que vos capitaines comprennent — l'immortalité change la perspective sur... tout. »

trans-unit.source: The stranger removes his traveling cloak with practiced grace, revealing elven armor beneath. "I have served alongside knights before," he says, inclining his head with courtly precision. "Honor and duty transcend the boundaries of race. Your Lady protects these lands, and I would see them defended from the darkness that consumes all." His pale features remain composed, though his bloodless lips betray no warmth. "Let us ride against our common foe."
trans-unit.target: L'étranger retire sa cape de voyage avec une grâce pratiquée, révélant une armure elfique en dessous. « J'ai servi aux côtés de chevaliers auparavant », dit-il, inclinant la tête avec une précision courtoise. « L'honneur et le devoir transcendent les frontières des races. Votre Dame protège ces terres, et je voudrais les voir défendues contre les ténèbres qui consument tout. » Ses traits pâles restent composés, bien que ses lèvres exsangues ne trahissent aucune chaleur. « Chevauchons contre notre ennemi commun. »

trans-unit.source: The robed figure bows with unexpected formality, then straightens to reveal elven features beneath his traveling garments. "I have walked your lands before, in ages past," he states, his voice measured and calm. "The Great Bastion holds back horrors I know all too well. Balance must be maintained against the Ruinous Powers." His ageless eyes study the Cathayan officials with scholarly interest. "I offer knowledge spanning millennia. Perhaps we can learn from one another."
trans-unit.target: La silhouette encapuchonnée s'incline avec une formalité inattendue, puis se redresse pour révéler des traits elfiques sous ses vêtements de voyage. « J'ai parcouru vos terres auparavant, dans des âges passés », déclare-t-il, sa voix mesurée et calme. « La Grande Bastion retient des horreurs que je ne connais que trop bien. L'équilibre doit être maintenu contre les Puissances Ruineuses. » Ses yeux sans âge étudient les officiels Cathayans avec un intérêt savant. « J'offre des connaissances s'étendant sur des millénaires. Peut-être pouvons-nous apprendre l'un de l'autre. »

trans-unit.source: The stranger pulls back his hood, revealing features unmistakably Asur—yet his eyes hold none of their typical disdain. "Cousin," he says, the word carrying neither mockery nor warmth. "I care nothing for ancient grudges. Chaos devours Druchii and Asur alike, and I have learned that survival demands... flexibility." A mirthless smile crosses his bloodless lips. "You understand pragmatism better than most. Shall we put it to use?"
trans-unit.target: 낯선 자가 후드를 뒤로 젖히며, 틀림없이 아수르의 특징을 드러냅니다—하지만 그의 눈에는 그들의 전형적인 경멸이 없습니다. "사촌," 그가 말합니다, 조롱도 온기도 담지 않은 단어. "고대의 원한은 관심 없습니다. 혼돈은 드루치와 아수르를 똑같이 삼키고, 저는 생존이... 유연성을 요구한다는 것을 배웠습니다." 기쁨 없는 미소가 그의 피 없는 입술을 가로지릅니다. "당신은 대부분보다 실용주의를 이해합니다. 그것을 활용할까요?"

trans-unit.source: The stranger's hood falls away, revealing an elven face untouched by time. "I know what you serve," he says flatly, meeting the gaze of the undead without flinching. "And I know what I am. We need not pretend otherwise." He adjusts the greatsword at his back with familiar ease. "Nagash's enemies are Chaos' servants. For now, that alignment of purpose is enough." His bloodless lips twist into something resembling dark amusement. "The Great Necromancer collects all things eventually. I simply choose the terms."
trans-unit.target: 낯선 자의 후드가 벗겨지며, 시간에 손대지 않은 엘프 얼굴을 드러냅니다. "당신이 무엇을 섬기는지 압니다," 그가 단호하게 말합니다, 움츠러들지 않고 언데드의 시선을 마주합니다. "그리고 제가 무엇인지도 압니다. 우리는 그렇지 않은 척할 필요가 없습니다." 그가 익숙한 편안함으로 등에 있는 대검을 조정합니다. "나가쉬의 적들은 혼돈의 하수인들입니다. 지금으로서는, 목적의 정렬이 충분합니다." 그의 피 없는 입술이 어두운 재미에 가까운 것으로 비틀어집니다. "위대한 강령술사는 결국 모든 것을 수집합니다. 저는 단지 조건을 선택할 뿐입니다."

trans-unit.source: The stranger sheds his salt-stained cloak, revealing elven features and ancient armor beneath. "I've sailed darker seas than these," he remarks, eyeing the shambling crew without disgust. "Blood is blood, whether taken on land or water." He produces his payment pouch, weighing it thoughtfully. "You hunt, you raid, you survive. I respect that." A knowing smile crosses his pale face. "And I suspect your captains understand—immortality changes one's perspective on... everything."
trans-unit.target: 낯선 자가 소금으로 얼룩진 망토를 벗으며, 아래에 엘프 특징과 고대 갑옷을 드러냅니다. "이보다 더 어두운 바다를 항해했습니다," 그가 혐오 없이 비틀거리는 선원들을 바라보며 말합니다. "피는 피입니다, 육지에서 취하든 바다에서 취하든." 그가 보수 주머니를 꺼내 신중하게 무게를 잽니다. "당신은 사냥하고, 약탈하고, 생존합니다. 그것을 존중합니다." 알 것 같은 미소가 그의 창백한 얼굴을 가로지릅니다. "그리고 당신의 선장들은 이해한다고 생각합니다—불멸은 모든 것에 대한 관점을 바꿉니다."

trans-unit.source: The stranger removes his traveling cloak with practiced grace, revealing elven armor beneath. "I have served alongside knights before," he says, inclining his head with courtly precision. "Honor and duty transcend the boundaries of race. Your Lady protects these lands, and I would see them defended from the darkness that consumes all." His pale features remain composed, though his bloodless lips betray no warmth. "Let us ride against our common foe."
trans-unit.target: 낯선 자가 숙련된 우아함으로 여행 망토를 벗으며, 아래에 엘프 갑옷을 드러냅니다. "전에 기사들과 함께 복무했습니다," 그가 궁정의 정밀함으로 고개를 숙이며 말합니다. "명예와 의무는 종족의 경계를 초월합니다. 당신의 여인이 이 땅을 보호하며, 저는 모든 것을 삼키는 어둠으로부터 그것들이 방어되는 것을 보고 싶습니다." 그의 창백한 얼굴은 평온하지만, 피 없는 입술은 따뜻함을 배반하지 않습니다. "함께 공통의 적에 맞서 기병을 이끕시다."

trans-unit.source: The robed figure bows with unexpected formality, then straightens to reveal elven features beneath his traveling garments. "I have walked your lands before, in ages past," he states, his voice measured and calm. "The Great Bastion holds back horrors I know all too well. Balance must be maintained against the Ruinous Powers." His ageless eyes study the Cathayan officials with scholarly interest. "I offer knowledge spanning millennia. Perhaps we can learn from one another."
trans-unit.target: 로브를 입은 인물이 예상치 못한 격식으로 절을 한 다음, 여행복 아래에서 엘프 특징을 드러내며 몸을 일으킵니다. "예전에, 오래 전에 당신의 땅을 걸었습니다," 그가 차분하고 침착한 목소리로 말합니다. "대장벽은 제가 너무 잘 아는 공포를 막습니다. 파멸의 힘에 맞서 균형이 유지되어야 합니다." 그의 늙지 않는 눈이 학자적 관심으로 카세이 관리들을 연구합니다. "천년에 걸친 지식을 제공합니다. 아마 서로에게 배울 수 있을 것입니다."

trans-unit.source: The stranger lowers his hood, revealing elven features. I am no friend of destruction, but our enemies forced my hand. Pocketing his coins he states, Returning to family after many years when they are in danger is right, no matter who that family is. Don't you agree?

trans-unit.source: I have fought and bled with warriors believing in Ulfic or Sigmar. trans-unit.source: I look forward to fighting alongside the hunters of the woods, cousin, states the asur in a friendly tone while packing his payment and travel cloak. Let us have a hunt that will be told of in centuries still!

Może nie jestem tak wielkim strzelcem jak ty, ale cię nie spowolnię. Lekko rozbawiony uśmiech pojawia się wokół jego bezbarwnych warg, zanim znika. trans-unit.source: The stranger pulls back his hood, revealing features unmistakably Asur—yet his eyes hold none of their typical disdain. "Cousin," he says, the word carrying neither mockery nor warmth. "I care nothing for ancient grudges. Chaos devours Druchii and Asur alike, and I have learned that survival demands... flexibility." A mirthless smile crosses his bloodless lips. "You understand pragmatism better than most. Shall we put it to use?"
trans-unit.target: Yabancı kapüşonunu geri çekiyor, açıkça Asur olan özellikleri ortaya çıkarıyor—ancak gözleri tipik küçümsemelerini barındırmıyor. "Kuzen," diyor, kelime ne alay ne de sıcaklık taşıyor. "Kadim düşmanlıklar umurumda değil. Kaos Druchii ve Asur'u eşit şekilde yutuyor ve hayatta kalmanın... esneklik gerektirdiğini öğrendim." Kansız dudaklarında neşesiz bir gülümseme geçiyor. "Pragmatizmi çoğundan daha iyi anlıyorsunuz. Kullanıma koyalım mı?"

trans-unit.source: The stranger's hood falls away, revealing an elven face untouched by time. "I know what you serve," he says flatly, meeting the gaze of the undead without flinching. "And I know what I am. We need not pretend otherwise." He adjusts the greatsword at his back with familiar ease. "Nagash's enemies are Chaos' servants. For now, that alignment of purpose is enough." His bloodless lips twist into something resembling dark amusement. "The Great Necromancer collects all things eventually. I simply choose the terms."
trans-unit.target: Yabancının kapüşonu düşüyor, zamandan dokunulmamış bir elf yüzünü ortaya koyuyor. "Kime hizmet ettiğinizi biliyorum," diyor dümdüz, ölümsüzlerin bakışına çekinmeden. "Ve ne olduğumu biliyorum. Başka türlü davranmamıza gerek yok." Sırtındaki büyük kılıcı tanıdık bir kolaylıkla ayarlıyor. "Nagash'ın düşmanları Kaos'un hizmetkarlarıdır. Şimdilik, bu amaç uyumu yeterli." Kansız dudakları karanlık bir eğlenceye benzeyen bir şeye bükülüyor. "Büyük Nekromancer sonunda her şeyi toplar. Ben sadece şartları seçiyorum."

trans-unit.source: The stranger sheds his salt-stained cloak, revealing elven features and ancient armor beneath. "I've sailed darker seas than these," he remarks, eyeing the shambling crew without disgust. "Blood is blood, whether taken on land or water." He produces his payment pouch, weighing it thoughtfully. "You hunt, you raid, you survive. I respect that." A knowing smile crosses his pale face. "And I suspect your captains understand—immortality changes one's perspective on... everything."
trans-unit.target: Yabancı tuz lekeli pelerinini çıkarıyor, altında elf özelliklerini ve kadim zırhı ortaya koyuyor. "Bunlardan daha karanlık denizlerde yüzdüm," diye söylüyor, sallanan mürettebatı tiksintisiz inceleyerek. "Kan kandır, karada veya denizde alınmış." Ödeme kesesini çıkarıyor, düşünceli bir şekilde tartıyor. "Avlıyorsunuz, yağmalıyorsunuz, hayatta kalıyorsunuz. Buna saygı duyuyorum." Solgun yüzünde bilen bir gülümseme geçiyor. "Ve şüpheleniyorum ki kaptanlarınız anlıyor—ölümsüzlük bakış açısını... her şeyde değiştiriyor."

trans-unit.source: The stranger removes his traveling cloak with practiced grace, revealing elven armor beneath. "I have served alongside knights before," he says, inclining his head with courtly precision. "Honor and duty transcend the boundaries of race. Your Lady protects these lands, and I would see them defended from the darkness that consumes all." His pale features remain composed, though his bloodless lips betray no warmth. "Let us ride against our common foe."
trans-unit.target: Yabancı seyahat pelerinini pratik bir zarafetle çıkarıyor, altında elf zırhını ortaya koyuyor. "Daha önce şövalyelerle birlikte hizmet ettim," diyor, saray hassasiyetiyle başını eğerek. "Onur ve görev ırk sınırlarını aşar. Hanımefendiniz bu toprakları koruyor ve onları her şeyi tüketen karanlıktan savunulduğunu görmek istiyorum." Soluk yüzü sakin kalıyor, kansız dudakları sıcaklık vermese de. "Ortak düşmanımıza karşı birleri sürmeye gidelim."

trans-unit.source: The robed figure bows with unexpected formality, then straightens to reveal elven features beneath his traveling garments. "I have walked your lands before, in ages past," he states, his voice measured and calm. "The Great Bastion holds back horrors I know all too well. Balance must be maintained against the Ruinous Powers." His ageless eyes study the Cathayan officials with scholarly interest. "I offer knowledge spanning millennia. Perhaps we can learn from one another."
trans-unit.target: Cüppeli figür beklenmedik bir resmiyet ile eğiliyor, sonra seyahat giysilerinin altında elf özelliklerini ortaya çıkarmak için doğruluyor. "Geçmiş çağlarda topraklarınızda yürüdüm," diye belirtiyor, sesi ölçülü ve sakin. "Büyük Sur çok iyi bildiğim korkuları geri tutuyor. Yıkım Güçlerine karşı denge korunmalıdır." Yaşlanmamış gözleri Cathay yetkililerini bilgin merakıyla inceliyor. "Bin yıllara yayılan bilgi sunuyorum. Belki birbirimizden öğrenebiliriz."

trans-unit.source: The stranger lowers his hood, revealing elven features. I am no friend of destruction, but our enemies forced my hand. Pocketing his coins he states, Returning to family after many years when they are in danger is right, no matter who that family is. Don't you agree?

trans-unit.source: I have fought and bled with warriors believing in Ulfic or Sigmar. We have the same foes, he states as he removes his travel robes, and I look forward to driving them back with you. Sharing my knowledge for the betterment of the world. His eyes look coldly at praying humans before returning their attention to the general and his guard.

trans-unit.source: I look forward to fighting alongside the hunters of the woods, cousin, states the asur in a friendly tone while packing his payment and travel cloak. I may not be as great of a shot as you are, but I won't slow you down. A slightly amused smile plays around his bloodless lips before disappearing. Let us have a hunt that will be told of in centuries still!
trans-unit.target: 我期待與森林的獵人並肩作戰，表親，這位阿蘇爾用友好的語氣說道，同時收拾著他的報酬和旅行斗篷。我可能不如你們射得準，但我不會拖你們後腿。一絲略帶玩味的微笑在他蒼白的嘴唇上浮現，然後消失。讓我們一起進行一場將被傳頌數個世紀的狩獵吧！
